data.hardware: DGX-A100とGH200 serversで8 GPU node以下のreal-system評価。64〜512 GPU規模はtestbed profileで拡張したSplitwiseSim discrete-event simulator。A100 nominal 1410MHz、DVFS floor 210MHz。KV RDMAは100Gbps InfiniBandで11.2GB/s、TCPは6.8GB/s。
data.software: SGLang + Mooncake KV transfer engineを基盤にPTA disaggregation、PSOpt、PSSched、PSRouteを実装。NVMLでlocked clocksとper-GPU power limitsを制御。
data.methodology: reasoningはMagpie-Reasoning/S1K、non-reasoningはAzure LLM inference coding/chat tracesを使用し、bursty Gamma arrivalも生成。default traffic mixはLC 30%、Flex 30% (alpha=3,rho=0.3)、BE 40%でsaturation throughput。static power-cap reduction 0〜60%と24h dynamic demand-response traceを評価。metricsはclass別goodput、P90/P99 TTFAT/TTLT、normalized BE throughput。baselinesはUniform、POLCA、SplitWise、DynamoLLM+、SLOs-Serve+。simulatorはheld-out measurementでcomponent MAPE <4%、power fit R2>0.95、8-GPU trace replayでgoodput差<4%、P90 TTLT差<9%。
data.scope: real-systemは8 GPU node以下、cluster-scale 64〜512 GPU結果はvalidated simulationを含む。reasoning/non-reasoning混在、static/dynamic cap、SLO mix driftを評価。power modelはhardware typeごとにrefitが必要。
